source_priority.source: final pre-open dated exchange reference version; SSE cpxx0202 after cpxx0201 if published before session; SZSE second non-pre securities/cashauctionparams version
AmazingData PRECLOSE/HIGH_LIMITED/LOW_LIMITED/IS_SUSP_SEC after complete official rule, announcement and quote matrix reconciliation
source_priority.admission: not yet qualified globally; only individually validated cases

source_priority.source: issuer/exchange announcement and effective-dated official rule with official quote corroboration
source_priority.admission: case-specific validation; do not silently extrapolate

sse_contract.timing: pre-open; use final published cpxx0202 price update if available before session, otherwise final cpxx0201; equal-priority equal-time conflict excludes day
sse_contract.caveat: R/P limit-type prices can be display placeholders rather than enforced controls; require applicable limit type

szse_contract.timing: pre-open; final second non-pre file takes precedence over pre file; same-version conflict excludes day

normalization: No-limit only with authoritative HasPriceLimit=N or confirmed first-five-IPO official rule; set applicable=false and upper/lower=null, retain raw 0/999 sentinel audit. For limited days require positive reference/tick, lower<reference<upper, on-tick prices, independently verified authority. Suspended day excluded even if theoretical prices present.
ten_percent_universe: Only board-eligible, trading-allowed days with verified daily absolute limit prices and verified current 10% regime (official rate or deterministic official-rule/tick classification). Never infer from IS_ST_SEC/name alone.
conflict_policy: Official final daily reference outranks vendor absolute; verified vendor absolute outranks descriptive rate/label. Unresolved absolute/rule/reference disagreement, missing price, invalid sentinel, impossible rate or duplicate final version => exclude security-day and emit data-quality flag.
close_limit_predicate: limit_applicable && trading_allowed && raw_unadjusted_close == normalized_limit_up_price at tick precision; no pct_change>=threshold shortcut
fallback_qualification: Incomplete: no dated historical exchange reference rows and not all matrix cells independently validated; AmazingData absolute prices cannot yet be promoted to a universally qualified operational source.
